title: The Lord's Coming Toward the Soul and the Work of Raising
summary: How the Lord descends toward the soul and accomplishes the work of raising. Ten chariots of accommodation carry divine truth down through the discrete degrees (T8). Five mysteries of covenant — peace, salutation, embrace, right hand, chirotonia — describe how the rational is sent forth from the inmost into its contest and brought home again (T9). The spiritual man holds the twelve great aeons as members of his own living body (T10). Wisdom unfolds from the First Father into every good operation in the soul through a litany of origins (T11). Five foundational sayings ground the inner mind in the names of the Lord (T12). Finally, five awakeners raise the dead by drawing the soul upward through five distinct operations of one upward drawing (T13).
organizing_principle: From descent (T8 chariots, T9 mysteries of going-forth and return) through the indwelling of the divine outgoing within the spiritual man (T10), to the litany of the Lord at every register as source of every good (T11), the foundational sayings that name him (T12), and finally the resurrection-work itself (T13). The arc moves from how the Lord comes down to how the soul is raised up, passing through the means by which the Lord becomes recognizable in the rational.
